This is a pre-meal photo, so I estimated each item from what is visible and had to guess what will be left over.

Items served:
- Orange juice, about 200 ml: roughly 90 kcal, 1.5 g protein, 21 g carbs, 0.4 g fat.
- One slice of toast, possibly with a spread: about 100 kcal, 4 g protein, 17 g carbs, 2 g fat.
- Avocado, about half a fruit sliced (roughly 70 g): about 115 kcal, 1.4 g protein, 6 g carbs, 10.5 g fat.

Together that is about 305 kcal served. Nothing in the photo indicates what will be left, so I assumed a small amount of avocado and toast remains, about 30 kcal. That leaves about 275 kcal eaten.

Estimated intake is about 275 kcal, with 6 g protein, 41 g carbs and 10 g fat.
